title: Division Threshold
tagline: We were not built to survive. We were built to be worth saving.
atmosphere: Industrial biotech, field operations, and moral pressure at the edge of survivability.
description: A science-fiction series about organosynthetic life built for impossible hazards—and the people forced to decide whether purpose is assigned or chosen.
worldPremise: An organosynthetic intelligence created to endure environments no human can survive begins asking questions its makers never planned to answer.

homepage.hook: An organosynthetic intelligence built for impossible hazards begins rewriting the purpose it was given.

seriesEngine: Every threshold event tests whether a created life can remain a tool once it begins making choices of its own.
coreConflict: The mission requires control; the life they created requires freedom.
readerEntry: Issue 01: Purpose Updated begins with the decision to keep an impossible life alive.
audiencePromise: Grounded, high-pressure science fiction where survival technology becomes a question of personhood.
